title: Practice: Sum the digits
description:
Return the sum of the decimal digits of n. Use a function argument, not stdin. Constraint: 0 <= n <= 1000000000. For n = 0, return 0.

Examples: 507 -> 12; 999 -> 27; 0 -> 0.
reference: int digit_sum(int n) { int sum = 0; while (n > 0) { sum += n % 10; n /= 10; } return sum; }
